culprit_citations.quoted_text: Blue Owl Cross-Strategy Opportunities LLC(3)(5)(24)(30)(31)(34) | Specialty finance equity investment | N/A | N/A | 137,069 | 137,069 | 136,815

findings.detail: The 1.1% value belongs to the continuation/subtotal row for the asset-based lending and fund finance equity group, not to the Blue Owl Cross-Strategy Opportunities LLC issuer row; 136,815 / 19,760,273 * 100 is about 0.692%.

rationale: Raw source table 90 row 16 prints Blue Owl Cross-Strategy Opportunities LLC with fair value 136,815 (thousands) and no percent of net assets in the row. The immediately following row 17 carries 1.1%, which is consistent with the aggregate fair value 218,184 divided by schedule Total Net Assets 19,760,273, not with the issuer's 136,815 fair value. The pipeline therefore attributed a subtotal/continuation-row percent to the issuer row, creating a real pct_of_net_assets identity error.
